title: Goodnight Friends Time
yt_description:
Help your little ones learn to say goodnight with this soothing song. Pip and friends will guide them through a bedtime routine, teaching the importance of sleep and quiet time. This gentle melody is perfect for winding down before bed.

🎵 Goodnight Friends Time

Goodnight
Time to sleep
Friends are tired

Pip is sleepy
Lulu too
Bo is dreaming

Goodnight friends
Sleep tight
See you tomorrow

Goodnight friends
Sleep tight
See you tomorrow

Goodnight
Sleep well
Friends

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.
